card.name: French context before French names
card.fires_on: Words in French-related passages (Brittany, French companies, French place names) where a French first name or place name is likely to come next. Often a spot just before or inside such a name.

modes.label: Before a French name
modes.description: A word right before a French person's name or place name in a French setting.
modes.example: all electronic noses are based on the same approach, “sort of a fingerprint pattern recognition, like in the human process of olfaction,” says Alpha MOS<< spokesperson>> Marion Bonnefille.

modes.label: Inside Breton and French spellings
modes.description: Pieces of the Breton and Gallo forms of Brittany in a language note.

modes.label: French regional text
modes.description: Linking words in text about French places or French-linked projects.
modes.example: He was born at Quimper<< in>> Brittany and educated by the Jesuits.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of other first names such as Denise or Roger, and slightly raises Cyril, Marion and words like concerned.
